items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: Sometimes they, like the restaurant up here, Arno's restaurant.

ctx.x: I'll make a note that the date is May the 31st, 1961, and we're interviewing Rudolph. How do you pronounce your last name? Bollier. Bollier. B-E-A-U-L-I-E-U. L-I-E-U. Because there's several names similar to that, and they're all spelled a little different. I saw another way to spell it yesterday in the paper. I was thinking about you then. Do you have any middle name? Peter. Peter. And your first name Rudolph. Is it a ... ...

Well how do you spell his first name? We're asking about his last name. Is it just... A-R-N-O-L-D. A-R-N-O-L-D. Uh-huh. So I wondered if it was some sort of a French pronunciation. Some of them like... That's right. Sometimes they, like the restaurant up here, Arno's restaurant. Yeah, that's right. They leave off the L-D on the end. That's...
